summary: The review of these candidates reveals several key findings: cdkn2a_mutation_status and cea_level are established as effect modifiers due to consistent signals in treatment-effect heterogeneity models and a lack of outcome prognostic value. Cavernous sinus enhancement and cerebellar hemisphere signal are identified as confounders, showing evidence for both treatment prediction and outcome prognosis. Other candidates, such as carboplatin administration, appear primarily prognostic, while several others lack sufficient evidence across model families to justify a role.
